entries.choice_handling_note: The Berserker sphere grant uses the shared martial-talent picker; Violent Challenge remains tied to the live Guardian Challenge and berserking states.
The Tinker transmission package and Arsenal Set grants use the shared martial-talent records; Guardian Challenge remains the live challenged-target state.
The required Gladiator sphere is represented by the first-level martial talent allocation.

choice_providers.label: Chosen Alignment
choice_providers.description: Choose one non-neutral component of the Paragon's alignment. Judging Challenge and later Paragon features use this component.
